Overview of Solothurn Region (Solothurn)

Solothurn Region (Solothurn) is located in the Solothurn region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Olten. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

RegionSolothurn
Capital cityOlten
Cities & municipalities23
Primary transport hubOlten Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Solothurn Region

Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Solothurn

When visiting cities across Solothurn, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Cheese fondue
  • Raclette
  • Rösti
  • Bircher muesli
  • Swiss artisanal chocolate

Best time to visit Solothurn

Best time to visit Solothurn: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports).
